user.title: Add an Apple Health device
user.description:
Create a private webhook for one iPhone or iPad. The iOS app will POST Apple Health data to it.

There are {metric_count} built-in metrics. Leave the allow-list empty to expose all of them.

data_description.name: Used as the Home Assistant device name, for example "Simon's iPhone".
data_description.secret: If set, the app must send the same value in the X-Webhook-Secret header.
data_description.metrics: Only these metrics become entities. Leave empty to enable all built-in metrics. Unknown metrics are always exposed as generic sensors.

webhook.title: Webhook ready
webhook.description:
Copy these values into the iOS app. The webhook URL is a credential: anyone who has it can send data to this Home Assistant instance.

**Webhook URL**

`{webhook_url}`

**Shared secret**

`{secret}`

If the URL above is only a path, prepend your Home Assistant base URL. Select **Submit** when you have copied the values.

**Scan with the iOS app**

The QR code below contains the webhook URL and shared secret. Scan it with the iPhone Camera to populate the app automatically.

data_description.qr_code: Scan this with the iPhone Camera. It contains the webhook URL and secret.
data_description.webhook_url: Read-only. Copy this URL into the app or scan the QR code.

init.title: Health Sync options
init.description:
**Webhook URL**

`{webhook_url}`

The webhook URL does not change. Update the shared secret or choose which of the {metric_count} built-in metrics become entities. Leave the allow-list empty to enable all of them.

Scan the QR code with the iPhone Camera to import the webhook URL and shared secret into the app.

data_description.secret: If set, the app must send the same value in the X-Webhook-Secret header.
data_description.metrics: Only these metrics become entities. Leave empty to enable all built-in metrics. Unknown metrics are always exposed as generic sensors.
data_description.qr_code: Scan this with the iPhone Camera. It reflects the saved secret; save and reopen after changing the secret.
data_description.webhook_url: Read-only. Copy this URL into the app or scan the QR code.
